title: San Francisco supervisor recalled after voting to close highway for car-free park
summary: Joel Engardio, who becomes fifth elected city official to be ousted in four years, says he stands by his decision A San Francisco supervisor was recalled Tuesday after he successfully pushed to turn a stretch of coastal highway used heavily by neighborhood motorists into a car-free park despite strong objections by some of his constituents. Joel Engardio became the fifth elected official in San Francisco to be ousted in a recall vote in four years. He conceded, saying in a statement that he accepted the outcome and still stood by his decision to help create a park called Sunset Dunes. Continue reading...
